E1.evidence: PR #251 (davetcoleman) "Fix xacro warnings in Jade" (commit 1c07a16 "Fix xacro warnings in Jade") updates the xacro files and launch invocations; maintainer gavanderhoorn approved and merged: "All changes are compatible with Indigo as well, so merging into `indigo-devel`." The warnings are defined in xacro's Jade sources (1.10.7). The PR body is empty; no log is quoted.

E2.evidence: xacro (the macro processor, separately released) deprecated in its Jade line the non-prefixed xacro tags ("deprecated: xacro tags should be prepended with 'xacro' xml namespace."), the xacro.py entry point ("xacro.py is deprecated; please use xacro instead") and redefinition of its global math symbols such as pi ("redefining global property: %s"). ur_description's .urdf.xacro files use <property>, <insert_block> and <property name="pi" .../>, and its upload launch files call $(find xacro)/xacro.py. The consumer must follow the provider's changed input language and entry point; the change is to the provider's declared interface, not deployment-only name binding or build configuration.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: ur_description on indigo-devel was written against Indigo xacro (1.9.x, whose default processor issues none of these warnings) and processed with Jade xacro (1.10.x); PR title "Fix xacro warnings in Jade".

E4.evidence: PR title/commit message "Fix xacro warnings in Jade"; the resolving diff replaces <property>/<insert_block> with <xacro:property>/<xacro:insert_block>, removes <property name="pi" value="3.14159265" />, and replaces xacro.py with xacro.

loudness_evidence: The provider's own deprecation diagnostics fire while xacro processes the model (PR/commit title "Fix xacro warnings in Jade"); xacro 1.10.7 prints warning("deprecated: xacro tags should be prepended with 'xacro' xml namespace.") followed by a sed script to fix the files, and xacro.py prints warning('xacro.py is deprecated; please use xacro instead'). The warning text itself is not quoted in the PR.

resolution.summary: Prefix all xacro tags in ur_description (<xacro:property>, <xacro:insert_block>), drop the local <property name="pi">, call $(find xacro)/xacro instead of xacro.py in the upload launch files, and change xmlns:xacro to http://ros.org/wiki/xacro.
resolution.evidence: PR #251 merged into indigo-devel 2016-12-29 (merge fa64ec6) after maintainer approval; no run with identified xacro revision is shown.

notes: The same PR also changes ur3/ur5/ur10_moveit_config launch/planning_context.launch from xacro.py to xacro (further compositions with the same provider). The xmlns:xacro URI change (http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro -> http://ros.org/wiki/xacro) is not required by xacro 1.10.7, which matches the xacro: prefix and whose own error hint still names xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro"; it is kept in the inventory but not as a failed condition. xacro 1.10.7 also warns "xacro: Traditional processing is deprecated. Switch to --inorder processing!" unless --inorder is given; the PR does not address it. Indigo xacro 1.9.5's default processor (src/xacro) warns only about non-prefixed <include>; the Jade behaviour lives there in src/xacro_jade, used with --inorder. consumer_built_against is inferred from the consumer's non-prefixed tags and xacro.py calls matching Indigo xacro 1.9.5; the resolved files match Jade 1.10.7. Element naming: xacro language tags and entry points are written as api:<tag> / api:<script>; api:pi is xacro's global math symbol. The pi-redefinition condition is code-level (the fix removes <property name="pi" value="3.14159265" />; xacro 1.10.7 puts math.__dict__ in global_symbols); the PR does not quote which warnings were seen.
